name: 2play
description: 2PLAY — Universal 2D Multiplayer Gaming Platform ("Play Together, Anywhere.")

scripts.build: npm run build -w @2play/shared && npm run build -w @2play/server && npm run build -w @2play/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @2play/shared && npm run typecheck -w @2play/server && npm run typecheck -w @2play/client && npm run typecheck -w @2play/tests
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @2play/shared && npm run test -w @2play/server && npm run test -w @2play/client
scripts.test:server: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @2play/server
scripts.test:client: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @2play/client
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @2play/tests
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration
scripts.clean: rimraf shared/dist server/dist client/dist tests/dist coverage .eslintcache
